# NaviWealth

> Local-first personal finance and health app for one Android phone. The
> client is NSH (Rust); business truth lives in the `finance-core` and
> `health-core` crates. Local-only: no backend, no sync, no account system;
> passphrase-encrypted local backups. AI recognition runs on device against
> user-owned LLM profiles through the `third_party/agent-runtime` submodule.

## Essential Docs

- [Documentation Index](docs/index.md): Human and AI entry point for the docs tree.
- [Agent Guide](AGENTS.md): Build commands, architecture rules, and coding conventions for AI agents.
- [Product Scope](docs/product/product-scope.md): What the NSH client builds and deliberately omits.
- [NSH Client Roadmap](docs/roadmap/roadmap-lifeos.md): Active delivery gates.
- [NSH Migration ADR](docs/architecture/adr/0001-nsh-client-migration.md): NSH direction, Android only.
- [Personal Local Scope ADR](docs/architecture/adr/0002-personal-local-scope.md): Personal, local-only reduced rewrite.
- [Flutter Retirement ADR](docs/architecture/adr/0003-flutter-retirement.md): Flutter and Sync backend retirement, catalog relocation, D1 archive ids.
- [Agent Runtime Current Architecture](docs/architecture/agent-runtime-current.md): Current Rust runtime code map, invariants, and maintenance guide.
- [Local Development](docs/development/local-development.md): Rust toolchain, crates checks, NSH Android debugging.
- [Branch Protection](docs/operations/branch-protection.md): CI checks and NSH release policy.

## Current Code Roots

- `apps/nsh-client/`: NSH (Rust) UI client and its headless tests.
- `crates/finance-core/`: Double-entry ledger, holdings, securities catalog truth.
- `crates/health-core/`: Meal recognition, nutrition, Garmin daily summaries.
- `third_party/agent-runtime/`: Provider-neutral LLM protocol and client (submodule).
- `third_party/market-data-rs/`: Market-data SDK (Tencent quotes).
- `assets/catalog/` + `tool/asset_catalog/`: Securities catalog bundle and its build/publish pipeline.

## Documentation Policy

Documentation describes the current implementation. Superseded documents are
removed rather than archived, except the explicitly archived Finance roadmap
and product-direction study, which are retained historical context. Retired
Flutter-era documents and code remain reachable at the `flutter-final` tag.
